description: Adds per-VLAN DoH blocking (allow_doh) and admin VLAN visibility (visible_vlans) columns to vlan_mappings, and refreshes the traffic_combined view for NAT-only traffic viewing.
notes: After deploying, review Admin → VLAN Config: DoH blocking is off (allow_doh=false) for every VLAN by default; tick 'Allow DoH' for VLANs that should bypass DNS-over-HTTPS blocking.
